scope: M1 runtime+memory scoped compiled-once functional proof only. Not M0 Go/Rust owner integration, real rtrb/eventfd, physical or product throughput qualification.

native.artifact_review: Downloaded exact ZIP from GitHub, independently verified ZIP/result.json/test.log SHA256 and result.json run/source, eight new named test cases in test.log; all96 unique r1 tests pass.

scoped_proof.ready: ReadyTurn uses preallocated caller Vec and already-ready <=32 each TX and RX; alternating class starting side, cooperative fake MonoNs 100us boundary, no batch-fill wait, low-frequency TurnStats.
scoped_proof.wake: WakeGate retains armed on undelivered notification; one test-only first signal suppression and second publication proves retry even when queue nonempty. Existing armed recheck and stop/inflight proofs retained.
scoped_proof.memory: Owner Arena allocate bounded return reap<=64, explicit bounded drain 64+32 out of96 from multiple final dropping producer threads with one-slot channel and preallocated fallback; stop cannot free last clone until return and generation slot increments.
scoped_proof.first_send: Eligible parity scheduled under first-send weighted service separate from low-priority repair; with_parity defaults20:20, with_parity_share k20/r4 and k20/r20 component fairness verified on 1-byte frozen packets; source first when both ready.
scoped_proof.regression: Previous88 r1 cases unchanged in coverage. Two legacy assertions corrected to reflect parity no longer being repair-secondary.

inherited_release_component.qualification: Historical Release owner actual-ready component test rerun on new SOURCE. CPU includes allocate/freeze/offers, unisolated. Not Workpack-specific full runtime cost or comparable product throughput.

root_shared_blocker.description: Worker branch old shared tools/r0_abi_bundle.py requires literal '3 passed' unfiltered output. Real Rust unit binary returned rc0, 98 passed and 1 ignored; root ABI workflow nevertheless failed, as separately disclosed.

interface.ready: runtime::ready_turn::ReadyTurn::run(&mut TxOwner,&mut RxOwner,MonoNs,now,&mut Vec<TxDispatch>,&mut Vec<RxPacket>); immediate borrowed ready-only, no drivers
interface.parity: TxOwner::with_parity_share(fresh,repair,parity,k,r) maps codec-authorized share; only preexisting FrozenRecord handles
interface.memory: Arena::drain_returns_bounded(max) owner-local, per-turn max64 recommended; Arena::drain_returns() unbounded control-only
interface.wake: WakeGate::notify() rearm on failed/missing notification, no OS notifier backend installed
interface.rollback: M0 can retain existing bounded TxOwner/RxOwner drain_ready_batch and previously qualified wake/Arena interfaces, omit new ReadyTurn/parity_share; production flags remain false.
